name: vibefinance
description: Explainable, personalised market intelligence from parallel AI agents.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && playwright test
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.backtest: npm run build -w shared && npm run backtest -w server
scripts.latency-report: npm run build -w shared && npm run latency-report -w server
